title: A method for the ethical analysis of brain-inspired AI

bias_targets.methodology: Philosophical and conceptual ethical analysis examining the assumption that the biological human brain is the ultimate or only standard for intelligence, identifying this as an epistemic and cultural risk in AI development.

Theoretical risk assessment identifying how calibrating brain-inspired AI on non-representative biological datasets (e.g., relying solely on adult brains rather than young brains) can introduce novel systemic biases regarding plasticity and dynamics.
